A.title: Agreeableness
A.summary: Agreeableness reflects your tendency to be compassionate and cooperative towards others.
A.description: This domain measures your inclination to be friendly, empathetic, and helpful, which greatly supports teamwork and positive workplace relationships.

result.low: You tend to be more direct and competitive, which can drive results but may require extra effort to maintain harmony in collaborative settings.
result.neutral: You balance cooperation with assertiveness, adapting your approach to suit different professional situations effectively.
result.high: You are naturally warm and cooperative, fostering trust and smooth collaboration in your teams.

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: Your willingness to believe in others' intentions and reliability.

result.low: You are cautious about trusting others, which can protect you but might slow down team dynamics.
result.neutral: You assess trust on a case-by-case basis, combining openness with prudence.
result.high: You readily trust colleagues, encouraging openness and strong partnerships.

morality.title: Morality
morality.description: Your tendency to be honest and straightforward in interactions.

result.low: You may prioritize strategic communication over full transparency, which can be useful but requires ethical awareness.
result.neutral: You balance honesty with tact, fostering respectful and clear communication.
result.high: You value integrity highly, building credibility and respect in your professional relationships.

altruism.title: Altruism
altruism.description: Your desire to help and support others without expecting anything in return.

result.low: You focus more on your own goals, which can drive personal achievement but may miss collaborative opportunities.
result.neutral: You help others when appropriate, balancing support with your own priorities.
result.high: You actively seek ways to assist colleagues, enhancing team cohesion and morale.

cooperation.title: Cooperation
cooperation.description: Your willingness to avoid conflict and work harmoniously with others.

result.low: You may challenge ideas directly, encouraging innovation but sometimes causing friction.
result.neutral: You choose your battles wisely, maintaining balance between collaboration and assertiveness.
result.high: You prioritize harmony, smoothing conflicts and promoting effective teamwork.

modesty.title: Modesty
modesty.description: Your tendency to be humble rather than seeking the spotlight.

result.low: You confidently promote your achievements, which can inspire others but may need balance.
result.neutral: You share credit appropriately, showing both confidence and humility.
result.high: You prefer to let your work speak for itself, fostering a respectful and inclusive environment.

sympathy.title: Sympathy
sympathy.description: Your ability to empathize with others' feelings and perspectives.

result.low: You may focus more on tasks than emotions, which can be efficient but might limit emotional connection.
result.neutral: You show empathy when needed, balancing emotional insight with professional focus.
result.high: You deeply understand colleagues’ perspectives, enhancing communication and support.

E.title: Extraversion
E.summary: Extraversion reflects your energy, sociability, and enthusiasm in social and work settings.
E.description: This domain measures how outgoing and assertive you are, which influences leadership, networking, and collaboration.

result.low: You prefer quieter environments and thoughtful reflection, bringing calm and focus to your work.
result.neutral: You adapt comfortably between social engagement and solitude, balancing energy effectively.
result.high: You thrive in social settings, energizing teams and driving dynamic interactions.

friendliness.title: Friendliness
friendliness.description: Your warmth and approachability towards others.

result.low: You may be reserved, which can encourage independence but might limit spontaneous connections.
result.neutral: You are friendly when appropriate, fostering positive but measured relationships.
result.high: You easily connect with others, creating welcoming and supportive environments.

gregariousness.title: Gregariousness
gregariousness.description: Your enjoyment of social gatherings and group activities.

result.low: You prefer small groups or solo work, focusing deeply on tasks.
result.neutral: You enjoy socializing in balance with focused work time.
result.high: You actively seek group interactions, energizing and motivating those around you.

assertiveness.title: Assertiveness
assertiveness.description: Your confidence in expressing opinions and leading.

result.low: You may be more reserved, listening carefully before contributing.
result.neutral: You assert yourself when needed, balancing confidence with openness.
result.high: You take charge naturally, inspiring others and driving initiatives.

activity_level.title: Activity Level
activity_level.description: Your pace and energy in daily tasks and projects.

result.low: You maintain a calm and steady pace, ensuring thoughtful progress.
result.neutral: You balance bursts of activity with periods of rest effectively.
result.high: You work energetically, often leading fast-paced projects.

excitement_seeking.title: Excitement Seeking
excitement_seeking.description: Your desire for stimulation and new experiences.

result.low: You prefer stability and routine, which supports consistency.
result.neutral: You seek excitement in moderation, balancing novelty with reliability.
result.high: You pursue new challenges eagerly, driving innovation and growth.

result.low: You may be more serious, focusing on practical details.
result.neutral: You maintain a balanced outlook, encouraging optimism when appropriate.
result.high: You bring enthusiasm and positivity, uplifting team morale.

N.title: Neuroticism
N.summary: Neuroticism measures your emotional stability and sensitivity to stress.
N.description: This domain reflects how you handle pressure and negative emotions, impacting resilience and workplace wellbeing.

result.low: You remain calm and composed under stress, providing steady leadership.
result.neutral: You experience occasional stress but manage it effectively to maintain performance.
result.high: You are sensitive to stress, which can motivate careful planning but may require strategies for emotional balance.

anxiety.title: Anxiety
anxiety.description: Your tendency to feel nervous or worried.

result.low: You stay relaxed even in challenging situations, helping to calm others.
result.neutral: You experience some worry but use it to prepare and improve outcomes.
result.high: You often feel anxious, which can highlight potential risks but may hinder focus.

anger.title: Anger
anger.description: Your propensity to feel frustration or irritability.

result.low: You maintain patience and tolerance, fostering a peaceful work environment.
result.neutral: You express frustration appropriately, balancing assertiveness with control.
result.high: You may react strongly to setbacks, which can signal passion but needs mindful management.

depression.title: Depression
depression.description: Your susceptibility to feelings of sadness or discouragement.

result.low: You maintain a positive outlook, supporting resilience and motivation.
result.neutral: You experience occasional low moods but recover effectively.
result.high: You may struggle with discouragement, highlighting the importance of support and self-care.

self_consciousness.title: Self-Consciousness
self_consciousness.description: Your awareness and sensitivity to others' opinions.

result.low: You are confident and self-assured, enabling clear decision-making.
result.neutral: You consider others' views thoughtfully without being overly influenced.
result.high: You are highly aware of social perceptions, which can foster empathy but may cause hesitation.

immoderation.title: Immoderation
immoderation.description: Your difficulty resisting urges or impulses.

result.low: You exercise good self-control, supporting consistent productivity.
result.neutral: You balance indulgence with discipline effectively.
result.high: You may struggle with impulse control, which can affect focus but also drive creativity.

vulnerability.title: Vulnerability
vulnerability.description: Your tendency to feel overwhelmed by stress.

result.low: You handle pressure well, maintaining clarity and calm.
result.neutral: You manage stress with occasional need for recovery.
result.high: You may feel overwhelmed easily, underscoring the value of support systems.

C.title: Conscientiousness
C.summary: Conscientiousness reflects your organization, dependability, and goal-directed behavior.
C.description: This domain measures your ability to plan, persist, and deliver quality work, essential for professional success.

result.low: You may prefer flexibility over structure, which can foster creativity but require focus management.
result.neutral: You balance organization with adaptability, adjusting to changing demands effectively.
result.high: You are highly organized and reliable, consistently achieving your goals with diligence.

self_efficacy.title: Self-Efficacy
self_efficacy.description: Your confidence in your ability to accomplish tasks.

result.low: You may doubt your abilities at times, benefiting from encouragement and skill-building.
result.neutral: You have a realistic sense of your capabilities, approaching challenges thoughtfully.
result.high: You trust your skills and tackle challenges with confidence.

orderliness.title: Orderliness
orderliness.description: Your preference for organization and tidiness.

result.low: You may work in a more spontaneous or flexible manner.
result.neutral: You keep things organized when necessary, balancing order with flexibility.
result.high: You maintain structured environments that enhance efficiency and clarity.

dutifulness.title: Dutifulness
dutifulness.description: Your commitment to fulfilling obligations and responsibilities.

result.low: You may prioritize personal goals over strict adherence to rules.
result.neutral: You fulfill duties reliably while adapting to context.
result.high: You take responsibilities seriously, building trust through dependability.

achievement_striving.title: Achievement Striving
achievement_striving.description: Your drive to meet and exceed goals.

result.low: You may set modest goals, focusing on balance over ambition.
result.neutral: You pursue goals steadily, balancing ambition with realism.
result.high: You are highly motivated to excel and achieve outstanding results.

self_discipline.title: Self-Discipline
self_discipline.description: Your ability to persist with tasks despite distractions.

result.low: You may struggle with follow-through, benefiting from supportive structures.
result.neutral: You manage distractions effectively, completing tasks reliably.
result.high: You demonstrate strong focus and persistence, ensuring task completion.

cautiousness.title: Cautiousness
cautiousness.description: Your tendency to think carefully before acting.

result.low: You may take risks readily, which can foster innovation but requires awareness.
result.neutral: You weigh options thoughtfully, balancing caution with decisiveness.
result.high: You carefully consider consequences, minimizing errors and risks.

O.title: Openness to Experience
O.summary: Openness reflects your curiosity, creativity, and willingness to embrace new ideas.
O.description: This domain measures your intellectual curiosity and preference for novelty, supporting innovation and continuous learning.

result.low: You prefer familiar routines and practical approaches, providing stability and focus.
result.neutral: You appreciate new ideas when relevant, balancing tradition with innovation.
result.high: You eagerly explore new concepts and experiences, driving creativity and growth.

imagination.title: Imagination
imagination.description: Your ability to think creatively and envision possibilities.

result.low: You focus on concrete details over abstract ideas.
result.neutral: You engage imagination when needed, combining creativity with practicality.
result.high: You generate innovative ideas that inspire and transform projects.

artistic_interests.title: Artistic Interests
artistic_interests.description: Your appreciation for art and beauty.

result.low: You may be more focused on functional and practical aspects.
result.neutral: You enjoy art and aesthetics in balance with other interests.
result.high: You value artistic expression, enriching your work with creativity.

emotionality.title: Emotionality
emotionality.description: Your awareness and expression of your own emotions.

result.low: You may keep emotions private, focusing on objective analysis.
result.neutral: You acknowledge emotions appropriately, balancing feeling with reason.
result.high: You are in tune with your emotions, enhancing empathy and self-awareness.

adventurousness.title: Adventurousness
adventurousness.description: Your willingness to try new activities and experiences.

result.low: You prefer routine and familiar environments.
result.neutral: You try new things selectively, balancing comfort with exploration.
result.high: You actively seek new experiences, embracing change and challenge.

intellect.title: Intellect
intellect.description: Your openness to complex ideas and abstract thinking.

result.low: You prefer straightforward and practical information.
result.neutral: You engage with abstract ideas when relevant and useful.
result.high: You enjoy intellectual challenges and deep thinking, fostering innovation.

liberalism.title: Liberalism
liberalism.description: Your openness to re-examining traditional values and authority.

result.low: You respect tradition and established norms.
result.neutral: You balance respect for tradition with openness to change.
result.high: You question conventions, encouraging progress and new perspectives.
